description.TR: İlk kelimelerden gerçek sohbetlere günlük İngilizce öğren.
description.EN: Learn everyday English, from first words to real conversations.
description.DE: Lerne Alltagsenglisch – von den ersten Wörtern bis zu echten Gesprächen.
description.FR: Apprends l'anglais du quotidien, des premiers mots aux vraies conversations.
description.ES: Aprende inglés cotidiano, desde las primeras palabras hasta conversaciones reales.
description.IT: Impara l'inglese di tutti i giorni, dalle prime parole alle conversazioni vere.
description.RU: Учи повседневный английский — от первых слов до настоящих разговоров.
description.ZH: 学习日常英语，从第一个单词到真实对话。

words.example: Hi, I'm Tom. Nice to meet you.
There are a hundred people here.
Pick a number from one to ten.
How many brothers do you have?

description.EN: Talk about the people close to you

description.FR: Les aliments et boissons de base

words.example: I buy fresh bread every morning.
I like my coffee with milk.
The milk is in the fridge.
She eats an apple every day.
I have an egg for breakfast.
We're having chicken and rice tonight.
My new shoes are very comfortable.

description.FR: Les pièces et objets de la maison
description.ES: Habitaciones y objetos de la casa

words.example: Their house has a big garden.
The TV is in the living room.
Put the plates on the table.

description.FR: Ce que tu fais chaque jour

words.example: I take a shower every morning.
I go to work by bus.
Don't forget to brush your teeth.
We go to bed at eleven.

description.EN: Days, months and telling the time
description.FR: Les jours, les mois et l'heure

words.example: I go swimming twice a week.
The shop is closed on Monday.
The film starts at eight o'clock.
What do you do on the weekend?

description.EN: Talk about the weather and seasons
description.FR: Parler du temps et des saisons
description.ES: Habla del tiempo y las estaciones

description.RU: Говори о погоде и временах года

words.example: I love the sound of rain.
The children are playing in the snow.
It's too windy for the beach.
We go to the sea every summer.
Winter here is long and dark.

description.TR: Bir şeyler al ve fiyat sor
description.EN: Buy things and ask for prices
description.DE: Dinge kaufen und nach Preisen fragen

words.example: I want to buy a new phone.
Fruit is cheap at the market.
Excuse me, how much is it?
Do you have this in a bigger size?
Can I have the receipt, please?
The bank is next to the post office.
The hospital is open all night.
We went for a walk in the park.
The museum is free on Sundays.
I need to go to the supermarket.
The train station is very close.
There's a market in the main square.
We walked across the old bridge.

description.EN: Ask the way and find it
description.DE: Nach dem Weg fragen und ihn finden

words.example: Turn right at the traffic lights.
Go straight ahead for two blocks.
The bakery is on the corner.
Is there a pharmacy near here?
The bus stop is next to the school.
Can you show me on the map?
We got lost in the old town.
Cross the street at the lights.
We arrived at the airport early.
Our hotel was near the beach.
The flight was two hours late.
We took the train to Paris.
Where did you go on vacation?
I'd like to book a room for two nights.

description.TR: Yemek sipariş et ve hesabı öde

words.example: Can we see the menu, please?
What would you like for dessert?
I have a reservation for eight people.
Do you have any vegetarian dishes?

description.FR: Le corps et les petits maux

words.example: I hit my head on the door.
The doctor will see you now.
Take this medicine twice a day.
I was sick all last week.
I have a doctor's appointment at ten.
She found a new job last month.
Our office is on the fifth floor.
I have a meeting at three.
My boss will be on vacation next week.
The salary is good, but the hours are long.
I'll send you an email later.
Do you have any experience in sales?

description.EN: Free time and things you enjoy
description.DE: Freizeit und was dir Spaß macht
description.FR: Le temps libre et tes passions
description.ES: Tiempo libre y lo que te gusta

words.example: What do you do in your free time?
I read a little before I go to sleep.
He cooks for his friends on Saturdays.
I'm learning to play the guitar.
We often go hiking in the mountains.

description.TR: Duygularını ve ruh halini ifade et
description.ES: Expresa emociones y estados de ánimo

words.example: He was angry about the noise.
We're really excited about the trip.
Don't be scared, the dog is friendly.
Your parents are proud of you.
I always get nervous before a presentation.
I was surprised to see her there.
What did you do last night?
I started learning English two months ago.
I forgot my keys at home.
When I was a child, I lived by the sea.
I lost my phone on the train.
We moved to a new apartment last year.

description.DE: Über die Zukunft sprechen, Meinung sagen
description.FR: Parler de l'avenir et donner son avis
description.ES: Habla del futuro y da tu opinión
description.IT: Parla del futuro e di' la tua
description.RU: Говори о будущем и делись мнением

words.example: What are your plans for the summer?
In the future, I want to live abroad.
Prices will go up next year.
I think it's a good idea.
In my opinion, the movie is too long.
Maybe we'll go to the beach on Sunday.
I hope you'll come to the party.
It's my dream to travel the world.

sentences.target_text: How many apples do you want?

translations.FR: Je bois du café tous les matins.

translations.IT: Mi piace la tua giacca blu.

sentences.target_text: She is wearing a red dress.

translations.ZH: 她穿着一条红色连衣裙。

sentences.target_text: The kitchen is small but bright.

translations.DE: Die Küche ist klein, aber hell.
translations.FR: La cuisine est petite mais lumineuse.
translations.ES: La cocina es pequeña pero luminosa.
translations.IT: La cucina è piccola ma luminosa.

translations.FR: Ferme la fenêtre, s'il te plaît.

sentences.target_text: I usually get up at seven.

translations.DE: Ich stehe normalerweise um sieben auf.
translations.FR: D'habitude, je me lève à sept heures.
translations.ES: Normalmente me levanto a las siete.
translations.IT: Di solito mi alzo alle sette.

translations.DE: Wir essen um acht zu Abend.
Im Winter ist es sehr kalt.
translations.FR: Il fait très froid en hiver.

translations.DE: Wir haben gestern das Museum besucht.
translations.FR: Nous avons visité le musée hier.
translations.ZH: 我们昨天参观了博物馆。

sentences.target_text: Is there a bank near here?

translations.DE: Gibt es hier in der Nähe eine Bank?
translations.FR: Il y a une banque près d'ici ?

translations.DE: Bieg an der Ecke links ab.
translations.FR: Tourne à gauche au coin de la rue.
translations.ES: Gira a la izquierda en la esquina.

sentences.target_text: The station isn't far from here.

translations.DE: Der Bahnhof ist nicht weit von hier.
translations.FR: La gare n'est pas loin d'ici.
translations.ES: La estación no está lejos de aquí.
translations.IT: La stazione non è lontana da qui.

sentences.target_text: Our flight leaves at six in the morning.

translations.DE: Unser Flug geht um sechs Uhr morgens.
translations.FR: Notre vol part à six heures du matin.
translations.ES: Nuestro vuelo sale a las seis de la mañana.
translations.IT: Il nostro volo parte alle sei del mattino.
translations.RU: Наш рейс вылетает в шесть утра.
translations.ZH: 我们的航班早上六点起飞。

sentences.target_text: I left my passport at the hotel.

translations.DE: Ich habe meinen Pass im Hotel vergessen.
translations.FR: J'ai oublié mon passeport à l'hôtel.
translations.ES: Me dejé el pasaporte en el hotel.
translations.IT: Ho dimenticato il passaporto in albergo.

sentences.target_text: Could we have the bill, please?

translations.DE: Können wir bitte die Rechnung haben?
translations.IT: Ci porta il conto, per favore?

sentences.target_text: I work in an office in the city center.

translations.DE: Ich arbeite in einem Büro im Stadtzentrum.
translations.FR: Je travaille dans un bureau au centre-ville.
translations.ES: Trabajo en una oficina en el centro.
translations.IT: Lavoro in un ufficio in centro.
translations.RU: Я работаю в офисе в центре города.
translations.ZH: 我在市中心的一间办公室工作。

sentences.target_text: She has a job interview tomorrow.

translations.FR: Elle a un entretien d'embauche demain.
translations.ES: Mañana tiene una entrevista de trabajo.
translations.IT: Domani ha un colloquio di lavoro.

sentences.target_text: In my free time I play the guitar.

translations.DE: In meiner Freizeit spiele ich Gitarre.
translations.FR: Pendant mon temps libre, je joue de la guitare.
translations.ES: En mi tiempo libre toco la guitarra.
translations.IT: Nel tempo libero suono la chitarra.
translations.RU: В свободное время я играю на гитаре.

translations.TR: Geçen hafta sonu doğa yürüyüşüne çıktık.
translations.FR: Nous avons fait de la randonnée le week-end dernier.
translations.ES: El fin de semana pasado hicimos senderismo.
translations.IT: Lo scorso fine settimana abbiamo fatto un'escursione.
translations.RU: В прошлые выходные мы ходили в поход.

sentences.target_text: I was nervous before the exam.

translations.DE: Vor der Prüfung war ich nervös.
Wir sind so stolz auf dich!
translations.FR: On est tellement fiers de toi !
Qu'est-ce qui s'est passé hier soir ?

sentences.target_text: I met my best friend ten years ago.

translations.TR: En yakın arkadaşımla on yıl önce tanıştım.
translations.DE: Ich habe meinen besten Freund vor zehn Jahren kennengelernt.
translations.FR: J'ai rencontré mon meilleur ami il y a dix ans.
translations.ES: Conocí a mi mejor amigo hace diez años.
translations.IT: Ho conosciuto il mio migliore amico dieci anni fa.
translations.RU: Я познакомился со своим лучшим другом десять лет назад.
translations.ZH: 我十年前认识了我最好的朋友。

sentences.target_text: Next year I'm going to learn Spanish.

translations.DE: Nächstes Jahr werde ich Spanisch lernen.
translations.FR: L'année prochaine, je vais apprendre l'espagnol.
translations.ES: El año que viene voy a aprender español.
translations.RU: В следующем году я буду учить испанский.

sentences.target_text: I think it will be sunny tomorrow.

translations.DE: Ich glaube, morgen wird es sonnig.
translations.FR: Je pense qu'il fera beau demain.
translations.IT: Penso che domani ci sarà il sole.
